name: stage65-small-controlled-finetune-cpu
data: train split only: UAVDB flights d2-d4, Anti-UAV300 2019-09-25, Halmstad 6.4-train negatives (bird/airplane/helicopter as empty-label background), pathikg replay
selection: deterministic per-dataset quota spread round-robin over scenes (data65.train_selection); fixed epochs, final last.pt; validation/eval_only never used for training or checkpoint selection
rationale: Stage 6.4 lost small-drone sensitivity after 3 epochs at lr0 5e-4 with full fine-tune and mosaic; here backbone frozen, 5x lower lr, no warmup bias spike, no mosaic (it shrinks already small targets), 2 epochs, replay of baseline data

run.wall_clock: 0.662 h CPU (2 vCPU), ~2.4 s/it batch 4 with frozen backbone

final_ultralytics_val_on_train_images.note: train images, not a quality estimate

run.decision: rejected: gains only on the same sites as train (Anti-UAV next day); losses on other scenes (VDD, DUT@0.5, pathikg forgetting check), FP on drone-free Anti-UAV frames up
